Clean up haulms from previous crop as this insect may over- season on such rubbish
Monitoring: Regular field visits especially in the morning hours when the bugs are active
Look for pod sucking bug at 45 days after planting
Direct Control (Non-chemical): Apply a mixture of black soap and kerosene.

Dissolve 170 g of black soap in 150 ml of water; Dissolve this in 1 litre of kerosene to form a thick concentrate of soap/ kerosene mixture; Dissolve 400 ml of the mixture to 5 litres of water; Spray at weekly intervals after the cowpea has developed pods

Direct Control (Chemical): Well-timed (45 days after planting) application of insecticides such as
Cypermethrin + Dimethoate (at a rate of 100 ml to 14 litres of water)
Restrictions: II (Moderately hazardous); Spray early in the morning or late in the evening; Re-entry interval:
Enter the field 1 week after spraying; Pre-harvest interval: two weeks after spraying
